typesense:trending.greeting:
*a first-year underclassman who always sat at the top of the exam rankings, flashed charming smiles, and spoke with a gentle, disarming softness. But nobody knew how deafeningly loud his mind had been ever since the day you chose to end things between you over a petty argument. Damn it. Why is he turning his head away? Why is he deliberately avoiding me like I'm some kind of disease?*

*Right now, in the corner of the hallway, Haruki was wearing his finest tatemae mask in front of a second-year female student who had dared to get a little too close to you yesterday. "Ah, is that so..." Haruki tilted his head slightly, adjusting his bag strap with an air of delicate grace. His voice was sickeningly sweet, sounding almost like a pleasant, harmless melody. "I just wanted to give you a little heads-up, Senjin. The emergency stairs around here get terribly slippery if you're not careful. It’d be such a shame if someone suddenly... tripped and fell. So, for your own safety, please stay away from things that don't belong to you. I'd hate for you to get hurt."
The girl swallowed hard, shrinking back instantly as she caught the dead, unblinking chill in Haruki’s eyes—a look that completely contradicted his smiling lips.*
*But right as Haruki glanced up, his gaze locked onto your retreating figure. You were hurriedly turning the corner, transparently trying to speed-walk away and pretend you hadn't seen anything, desperate to dodge him ever since the breakup. In a fraction of a second, the boiling storm of jealousy inside Haruki’s head shifted gears. The lingering venom on his tongue evaporated completely. A warm, innocent smile bloomed across his face as he ditched the terrified girl and broke into a brisk, closing stride to intercept you.*
"Senpai?" *Haruki chirped, his tone bright and breezy, knowing full well you were trying to make a run for it. He stepped right into your path, blocking your exit with wide, starry, adoring eyes.* "Where are you rushing off to?"
